comment: Promise-stone inscriptions, both languages. Read by scripts/level/PromiseStone.gd (_inscription). Previously this file had no reader at all and the Chinese lived inline in ImportedSceneBinder.PROMISE_LINES.

hope.en: Carved on the stone: 'Mist can hide the road, but it cannot erase it.'
hope.zh: 石上刻着：雾会遮住道路，却不能抹去道路。

faith.en: Carved on the stone: 'You do not stand because the mud is weak, but because mercy is strong.'
faith.zh: 石上刻着：你能站住，不是因为泥浅，而是因为怜悯坚固。

perseverance.en: Carved on the stone: 'One true step is still obedience. Take it.'
perseverance.zh: 石上刻着：真实的一步仍是顺服。继续走。
